aml_transaction_monitoring.obligation: Ongoing monitoring of customer transactions and timely investigation and reporting of suspicious activity (AML/CFT law — illustrative).

controls.name: Daily transaction-monitoring scenario run with completeness reconciliation
controls.requirement: All in-scope transactions screened by scenarios TM-01..TM-06 every business day

evidence.title: Q3 scenario run log and record-count reconciliation

controls.name: Alert triage within 5 business days of generation
controls.requirement: Every alert dispositioned by a level-1 analyst within 5 business days
open_issues: ISS-2026-031: 3 alerts triaged late during the August fraud-ring surge (staffing)

controls.name: Case decision within 30 days and regulatory report within 30 days of determination
controls.requirement: Escalated cases decided within 30 calendar days; suspicious-activity reports filed within 30 days

evidence.title: Q3 case decision and filing timeliness (12 cases)

sanctions_screening.obligation: Screen customers and payments against applicable sanctions lists and block or freeze where required (sanctions regulations — illustrative).

controls.name: Real-time payment screening of wires against the consolidated list
controls.requirement: 100% of outgoing and incoming wires screened before release

controls.name: Potential-match disposition within 24 hours
controls.requirement: Potential matches cleared or escalated within 24 hours; payment held meanwhile
open_issues: ISS-2026-035: 2 weekend hits cleared after 31 and 38 hours

controls.name: List updates loaded within 24 hours of publication
controls.requirement: Screening lists refreshed within 24h of each publication

evidence.title: List load timestamps vs publication, Q3

open_issues: ISS-2026-029: 2026-08-15 update loaded after 41 hours (vendor feed outage)

kyc_refresh.obligation: Keep customer due-diligence information current on a risk-based cycle and verify beneficial owners of legal entities (AML/CFT law — illustrative).

controls.name: Risk-based periodic review (high 12m, medium 24m, low 36m)
controls.requirement: Periodic reviews completed by due date

evidence.title: Overdue periodic reviews by risk tier, 2026-09-30

open_issues: ISS-2026-022: 214 overdue reviews (3.1% of book); 19 are high-risk customers

controls.name: Beneficial-ownership verification for legal entities at onboarding

wealth_suitability.obligation: Recommendations must be suitable for the client's profile, documented, and supervised (investor-protection rules — illustrative).

controls.name: Annual suitability profile review
controls.requirement: Client profile reviewed at least every 12 months
open_issues: ISS-2026-038: 4.8% of profiles older than 12 months (e.g. WM-6178)

controls.name: Complex-product pre-approval and eligibility check
controls.requirement: Complex products only for eligible clients with documented pre-approval
open_issues: ISS-2026-040 (critical): leveraged ETP held in Conservative IRA WM-3115 via unsolicited order; private-credit interval fund sold to ineligible client in 2025

controls.name: Record of advice retained for every recommendation
controls.requirement: Record of advice filed and supervisor-approved within T+1

complaints_handling.obligation: Acknowledge, investigate and resolve complaints fairly and on time (consumer-protection rules — illustrative).

controls.name: Acknowledge within 5 business days, resolve within 30 days

evidence.title: Complaint SLA report Q3 (cards complaints spike in August)

open_issues: ISS-2026-033: card-fraud complaint surge in August breached 30-day SLA for 4 sampled cases

data_retention.obligation: Retain transaction and due-diligence records for at least 5 years after the relationship ends (record-keeping rules — illustrative).

controls.name: Records retained >= 5 years and retrievable within 48 hours
controls.requirement: Retention schedule enforced; retrieval test passed
